description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractVueController' within the OrangeHRM project. It serves as a base class for Vue.js integrated controllers, handling templating, component management, and request processing workflows for a web application related to Human Resource Management. The class manages Twig templating, component setting, request lifecycle methods, and response generation, providing a structured framework for subclasses to implement specific controller logic.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract base class for Vue.js integrated controllers in the OrangeHRM system. It manages Twig templating, component setup, and the request handling lifecycle, providing hooks for initialization, pre-rendering, rendering, and post-rendering processes. Designed to be extended by concrete controllers that implement specific logic.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Retrieves the current Twig Environment instance.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename used for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Associates a Vue component with this controller, ensuring it is set before handling is marked as complete.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the Vue component associated with this controller.

methods.name: init
methods.description: A hook method for subclasses to perform initialization tasks.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook for tasks before rendering, can modify the request.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component to a string using Twig, incorporating context parameters.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook after rendering, for additional processing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process a request, executing pre-render, render, and post-render steps, returning a Response.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the attribute bag containing context data for rendering.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles a bad request scenario by setting a default component and marking as handled.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object and marks the request as handled if applicable.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks if the request has already been handled.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Explicitly sets whether the request is considered handled.
